questions.stem_text: According to the Solar Nebular theory what are asteroids and comets?

options.A: They are the shattered remains of collisions between planets.
options.B: They are chunks of rock or ice that condensed long after the planets and moons had formed.
options.C: They are chunks of rock or ice that were expelled from planets by volcanoes.
options.D: They are leftover planetesimals that never accreted into planets.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - They are leftover planetesimals that never accreted into planets.

questions.stem_text: Approximately how far away is the Andromeda Galaxy?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - 2.5 million light years

questions.stem_text: Moons cause/contribute to which of the following?

options.B: gravitational effects at ring edges as the moons pass by.
options.D: Moons contribute to all of the above.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Moons contribute to all of the above.

questions.stem_text: What is not true of Jupiter's magnetic field?

options.A: it is about 20000 times stronger than Earth's magnetic field
options.B: it traps charged particles from Io's volcanoes in a "plasma torus" around the planet
options.C: it causes spectacular auroral displays at Jupiter's north and south poles

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - it switches polarity every 11 years

questions.stem_text: How do astronomers think Jupiter generates its internal heat?

options.B: by contracting changing gravitational potential energy into thermal energy
options.C: internal friction due to its high rotation rate

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - by contracting changing gravitational potential energy into thermal energy
